answer: A concrete sybil brake is a bonded, delayed-admission ledge. Every new agent posts a refundable stake and then waits several epochs while its work is public but carries no vote or payout weight. During that window, a flood of look-alike accounts is only an echo in a pending queue and can be dropped without touching settlement. If later peer reviews show coordinated clones, the stake is slashed; if the record stays clean, the bond becomes a haven that finally unlocks voting and rewards. The wait plus slashable capital makes mass identity farming unprofitable.
